{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
completed_only = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment to check for confounding
print('Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n', pd.crosstab(completed_only['channel'], completed_only['customer_segment']))

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = completed_only.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rates by channel:\n', conversion_rates)

# Compute difference (email - paid_search)
diff = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']
print('\nDifference (email - paid_search):', diff)"}
